title: Llms, Virtual Users, and Bias: Predicting Any Survey Question Without Human Data
benchmark_measurement: The predictive accuracy of LLMs for survey responses across different religious groups, aiming to identify performance disparities and potential biases.
findings: LLMs exhibited varying accuracy across different religious groups. They performed better when predicting responses for Christian (Roman Catholic, Evangelical, Eastern Orthodox, Protestant) and Non-religious groups, and less accurately for Hindu, Buddhist, and Islam groups. This indicates potential biases in the models. Furthermore, uncensored versions of LLMs consistently outperformed their censored counterparts in predictive accuracy across all religious groups.
